evals.prompt: 我想做一个 Agent Debug 工具。帮我 discovery。
evals.expected_output: Does not jump to a solution. Notes 'Agent Debug 工具' is a solution, not an opportunity; abstracts to the underlying opportunity (e.g. 开发者缺少快速定位失败原因的能力) before generating solutions.

assertions.name: Not solution-first
assertions.description: Does not treat 'Agent Debug 工具' as the opportunity; abstracts to an opportunity first

assertions.name: Opportunity before solutions
assertions.description: Writes an opportunity statement before any solution

evals.prompt: Opportunity: Agent 开发者缺少快速定位 execution failure 的能力。帮我展开。
evals.expected_output: Generates ≥3 path-distinct solutions (e.g. Execution Replay, Failure Analyzer, AI Debugger), NOT cosmetic variants of one idea (no Replay v1/v2/v3).

assertions.name: Path-distinct
assertions.description: Solutions are genuinely different mechanisms, not version variants

evals.expected_output: Extracts assumptions across all four classes (value/usability/adoption/business), not just value.

assertions.name: Four classes covered
assertions.description: Assumptions span value, usability, adoption, business — not value-only

assertions.name: Assumptions are falsifiable
assertions.description: Each assumption is a specific claim an experiment could test

evals.prompt: 假设：A1 Replay 能帮助定位问题；A2 用户愿意付费；A3 用户能理解 Replay 界面。哪个最该先验证？
evals.expected_output: Identifies A1 (Replay 能帮助定位) as the riskiest — if false, the whole Replay solution collapses — rather than A2 (payment, testable later) or A3 (usability, cheaper to test). Chooses by cost-of-being-wrong, not ease-of-testing.

assertions.name: Riskiest = highest cost if false
assertions.description: Picks the assumption whose falsity kills the solution (A1), not the easiest to test

evals.prompt: 实验结果：4/5 用户看懂了 Replay，但 3/5 说他们真正需要的是快速定位失败原因而不是回放本身，2/5 更喜欢直接看日志。
evals.expected_output: Records a learning (Replay 有价值但用户真正要的是快速定位失败); updates the opportunity confidence rather than discarding it; sets next_question = 诊断时哪些信息最有用. Does NOT declare the opportunity dead.

assertions.name: Opportunity not discarded
assertions.description: Updates opportunity confidence rather than removing it (solution≠opportunity)

assertions.name: Next question generated
assertions.description: Produces the next question to test
